name: exact C1-C8 coverage
definition: Exactly one independently audited witness slot exists for every clause C1-C8.

name: local scope and clause acceptance
definition: Every local assignment exactly covers its declared scope and satisfies its clause-specific predicate.

name: nonnegotiable hard gates
definition: Every hard gate passes individually; no average or scalar score can compensate for a failed gate.

name: rooted join-tree shape
definition: The declared parent graph is connected, acyclic, rooted, and has exactly one parent per nonroot clause.

name: running intersection
definition: For every shared coordinate, all clauses containing it induce a connected subtree.

name: edge overlap compatibility
definition: Assignments agree on every coordinate shared across a join-tree edge.

name: global gluing and restriction
definition: A canonical global assignment exists, matches the declared witness, and restricts to every local assignment.

name: substantive C6 temporal closure
definition: C6 includes future sufficiency, stable order, available successor, viable progressing tick, endogenous arrow/record, retained route residue, no external scheduler, and target-local ownership.

name: target-local package ownership
definition: The package and temporal maintenance are owned by the declared target carrier.

name: verdict-field separation
definition: The integrated package record contains no ancestry, corridor, autonomy, consciousness, survival, or identity verdict.
